content: chokidar (v5, ESM-only, Node 20.19+) is battle-tested (~30M repos) and fine for small-to-medium trees; @parcel/watcher is a native C++ addon, faster on large trees (50k+ files), used by VSCode/Nx/Tailwind, but ships platform-specific prebuilt binaries. For a small .planning/ directory tree, either works; native Rust notify crate is the natural choice inside a Tauri backend instead of a Node watcher.
